CMR.note: The article states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
The tax fraud model is a sector system, not general administration; the DGI 2026-2028 AI plan is only a plan.

facts.fact: Researchers from the universities of Ngaoundere and Dschang and ESSCA say their tax fraud detection model was tested at three tax centres, which the authors report cut processing time by 67%; Business in Cameroon says the DGI has not corroborated the pilot.
facts.system: Machine-learning tax fraud detection system (WorldCIST 2026 chapter)

systems.platform: XGBoost, Random Forest, SVM, Isolation Forest, autoencoders

facts.fact: Researchers at the universities of Ngaoundere and Dschang and ESSCA report building a machine-learning tax fraud model for Cameroon, trained on 3.2 million records and piloted at three tax centres, per Business in Cameroon.
facts.system: Machine-learning tax fraud detection system (WorldCIST 2026 chapter)

CMR.note: The article states no private money put into a digital business.
